title: Event
description: Append-only event record written to the ledger 'events' tab on every job state transition. (scope plan §6.4, G-13, AD-12, AD-13)

job_id.description: Reference to the AssemblyJob that produced this event.

workspace_id.description: Immutable workspace identifier. Required on every workspace-owned record (AD-13).

event_type.description: Dot-separated event type in the form '<entity>.<to_status>' (e.g. 'job.awaiting_review').

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 timestamp when this transition occurred. (scope plan §6.4)

actor.description: Identity that caused the transition: 'service' for the executor, or a member ID for human actions.

detail.description: Arbitrary structured detail about the event (e.g. output_document_id, block count). Must not contain PII or document content (SB-06).
